sections.heading: Safe driving tips — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: safe driving tips within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Visual search and speed; Water and stopping distance; Space around the vehicle; Communicating movements; Preventing hot-vehicle injuries. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Visual search, speed adjustment, curves, slippery roads, water hazards, all stopping and following values, side and rear space, horns, signals and hot-vehicle prevention are represented. The externally attributed annual child-death count is withheld because its original authority is not verified. No blanket legal immunity is claimed for rescue. The slide-braking statement conflicts with the winter section's no-braking instruction and remains review debt.
